subtitle: Cross-check of 20/Oct/2026, 16th day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 20/Oct, 19:55 BRT, the twenty-eight national polls conducted after the vote, including the two of 20/Oct (Alfa Inteligência and Real Time Big Data), the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 19 and 20/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 19.50% (cumulative volume USD 27.44M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 20/Oct, 19:55 BRT, falls 4.00pp against the confirmed reading of 19/Oct at 15:42 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLLS: behind in the two national polls of 20/Oct, with 45.9% to 48.8% in Alfa and 45% to 48% in Real Time Big Data; 46.4% to 44.6% in Vox Brasil of 18/Oct.
fortes: He leads both Vox Brasil polls conducted after the vote: 46.4% to 44.6% on 18/Oct, within the 2.15-point margin, with 51% of the valid votes, and 44.2% to 42.7% on 09/Oct.

In the national polls of 19/Oct, the distance to Flávio Bolsonaro in total votes fell against each pollster's previous wave: from 5.4 to 2.2 points in AtlasIntel, from 3 to 0.6 in BTG/Nexus and from 1.5 to 0.8 in Futura/100% Cidades, and in valid votes from 6.2 to 3 points in DataTrends.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 27.44M.
fracos: He stands at 19.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 20/Oct, 19:55 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 60.60pp.

He trails in twenty-five of the twenty-eight national polls conducted after the vote, among them the two of 20/Oct, with 45.9% to 48.8% in Alfa and 45% to 48% in Real Time Big Data, and the five of 19/Oct.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In Alfa of 20/Oct the government is disapproved by 50% and approved by 46%; in AtlasIntel of 19/Oct, disapproved by 52.3% and approved by 46.2%.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 19.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 27.44M), confirmed reading of 20/Oct, 19:55 BRT, and falls 4.00pp against the confirmed reading of 19/Oct at 15:42 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 Two new national polls came out on 20/Oct, both with Flávio Bolsonaro ahead. Alfa Inteligência, with 2,700 in-person interviews from 15 to 19/Oct, gives him 48.8% and Lula 45.9% in total votes and 51.5% to 48.5% in valid votes (UOL, Estadão and CNN Brasil). Real Time Big Data, with 2,000 telephone interviews across the country from 15 to 19/Oct, gives 48% to 45% in total votes and 52% to 48% in valid votes (CartaCapital, CNN Brasil and Metrópoles). The fieldwork of both ends on 19/Oct, the day after the Band debate. Against each pollster's previous wave, both conducted before the first round, the distance in total votes goes from a tie at 43% to 2.9 points in Flávio Bolsonaro's favour in Alfa and from 1 to 3 points in Real Time Big Data. In Vox Brasil of 18/Oct he has 46.4% against 44.6%. On 20/Oct, Lula filed with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) and the Supreme Court a document authorizing the lifting of the bank and phone secrecy of himself and his relatives if Flávio Bolsonaro does the same, and André Mendonça will be the rapporteur of the request at the TSE (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and Agência Brasil); allies of Flávio Bolsonaro argue that he should not accept (O Globo). After the promulgation, Lula said the 6x1 work schedule will return if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the election (O Globo and Valor), and on 13/Oct he announced Prospera MEI, with forgiveness of individual microentrepreneurs' debts estimated at R$ 12.6 billion (Poder360 and Estadão). ⚖️ On 20/Oct, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) asked the Supreme Court for more time in the inquiries into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, and Justice Edson Fachin is to decide (Estadão and G1). ⚖️ In response to the decision in which TSE Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze gave Meta 24 hours to prove equal treatment of the campaigns, the company told the court on 20/Oct that it applies the same criteria to content from Lula and from Flávio Bolsonaro and asked for a meeting with the justice (Valor, JOTA and VEJA). On 19/Oct the ANPD, Brazil's data protection authority, had given the company five days to explain the suspension of accounts and the removal of posts (G1 and Metrópoles). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the campaign agenda: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 80.10% (cumulative volume USD 23.76M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 20/Oct, 19:55 BRT, rises 3.25pp against the confirmed reading of 19/Oct at 15:42 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLLS: ahead in twenty-five of the twenty-eight post-vote national polls and in the two of 20/Oct, with 48.8% to 45.9% in Alfa and 48% to 45% in Real Time Big Data; 44.6% to 46.4% in Vox Brasil of 18/Oct.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 80.10% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 20/Oct, 19:55 BRT.

He leads twenty-five of the twenty-eight national polls conducted after the vote, among them the two of 20/Oct, with 48.8% to 45.9% in Alfa and 48% to 45% in Real Time Big Data, and the five of 19/Oct.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in both Vox Brasil polls conducted after the vote, with 44.6% against 46.4% on 18/Oct and 42.7% against 44.2% on 09/Oct; in the national polls of 19/Oct, his lead in total votes fell against each pollster's previous wave, from 5.4 to 2.2 points in AtlasIntel, from 3 to 0.6 in BTG/Nexus and from 1.5 to 0.8 in Futura/100% Cidades.

⚖️ On 18/Oct, Estadão reported, and Folha de S.Paulo and G1 confirmed, that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) (PF) took to the Supreme Court an investigation into suspected money laundering involving the lawyer Willer Tomaz, his companies and Flávio Bolsonaro, with Alexandre de Moraes drawn as rapporteur; the case moved up from the Federal Court in Rio Grande do Sul on 08/Oct because of the senator's privileged forum (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz say they are friends and deny having business together (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 20/Oct, a technical note from the Finance Ministry named Willer Tomaz as the country's largest sports-betting gambler in 2025, with R$ 5 billion wagered (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo).

⚖️ The government leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues, is collecting signatures for a complaint to the Senate Ethics Council that seeks the loss of Flávio Bolsonaro's mandate for breach of decorum, citing his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro; the document has yet to be filed (Folha de S.Paulo and Valor).

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

On 19/Oct the ANPD, Brazil's data protection authority, had given the company five days to explain the suspension of accounts and the removal of posts (G1 and Metrópoles). 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital).
